s4_attain_by_region: SELECT h.region AS sales_region, AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o JOIN hr_bridge h ON o.employee_id = h.employee_id GROUP BY h.region ORDER BY h.region
s4_revenue_by_region: SELECT h.region AS sales_region, SUM(o.closed_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM opportunities o JOIN hr_bridge h ON o.employee_id = h.employee_id GROUP BY h.region ORDER BY h.region
s4_attain_advneg: SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o JOIN rep_course_flags f ON o.employee_id = f.employee_id WHERE f.completed_advneg = TRUE
s4_attain_no_advneg: SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o JOIN rep_course_flags f ON o.employee_id = f.employee_id WHERE f.completed_advneg = FALSE
s4_attain_by_advneg: SELECT f.completed_advneg, AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o JOIN rep_course_flags f ON o.employee_id = f.employee_id GROUP BY f.completed_advneg ORDER BY f.completed_advneg
s4_assess_emea: SELECT AVG(a.score) AS avg_assessment_score FROM assessment_scores a JOIN learners l ON a.learner_id = l.learner_id JOIN hr_bridge h ON lower(replace(l.email, '.contractor', '')) = lower(h.work_email) WHERE h.region = 'EMEA'
s4_attain_emea: SELECT AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o JOIN hr_bridge h ON o.employee_id = h.employee_id WHERE h.region = 'EMEA'
s4_attain_by_distract: SELECT f.completed_distract, AVG(o.quota_attainment) AS avg_quota_attainment FROM opportunities o JOIN rep_course_flags f ON o.employee_id = f.employee_id GROUP BY f.completed_distract ORDER BY f.completed_distract
s5_advneg_lift: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN f.completed_advneg THEN o.quota_attainment END) - AVG(CASE WHEN NOT f.completed_advneg THEN o.quota_attainment END) AS advneg_attainment_lift FROM opportunities o JOIN rep_course_flags f ON o.employee_id = f.employee_id
s4_unans_manager: SELECT 'unanswerable: the certified semantic model has no direct manager attribute for reps' AS note
s4_unans_age: SELECT 'unanswerable: the certified semantic model has no learner age or age band attribute' AS note
